# Analytikern om Rusta: "Gissar på svagt upp"

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-09  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon, 9 September 2026: US stocks fell on worries about higher oil prices, with Brent near $100 after reported US strikes on Iranian oil-export sites at Kharg and Jask. Tech stocks held up on AI deals (Corning–Verizon, Qualcomm–Amazon, Intel +10%). Stockholm was indicated to open lower. Rusta's strong Q1 report (10% sales growth, gross margin up almost 2pp, plans for 65-80 new stores) was the main company story, and the hosts guessed the stock would rise 2-3%. Hoist Finance raised its financial targets, but the hosts noted the stock is already highly valued. They also covered Inditex's report and its read-across to H&M, Handelsbanken's stronger economic forecast, JP Morgan's negative watch on Elekta, and Cloetta's US launch.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 RUSTA — Rusta | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Strong Q1: +10% sales, gross margin +~2pp, margins outside Sweden rising, aggressive store rollout, net cash. Host expects stock up 2-3% today.

#### Reasoning

Host Ture called the report strong: sales growth, better gross margin helped by currency, and all segments improving. Margins in online, Finland and Germany rose from 3.7% to 6.2% with 16% growth. If Norway and Finland move toward Swedish margins there is a lot of profit to unlock. The 65-80 store rollout is funded by net cash, and new stores turn profitable within a year. The near-term call is modest ('svagt upp', 2-3%).

#### Sell Triggers

- if margins in Norway/Finland/Germany stop improving
- if new stores fail to reach profitability within a year
- if FX tailwind reverses and gross margin falls back
- if like-for-like growth stalls

> *"Ture Rusta. Svagt upp. 2–3 %, gissar jag."*

---

### 🟡 HOFI — Hoist | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Raised ROE and dividend targets, but it has already reached them. The stock has run hard and is highly valued, so the new targets may not lift it.

#### Reasoning

Hoist is described as a stock-market 'darling' that executes well, and AI could make debt collection much more efficient. But the raised targets (20% ROE, 30-40% payout) are ones it says it has already reached. The earnings-growth target stays at 15% a year to 2030, which raises doubt about keeping up fast growth. With a high valuation, upside from the capital markets day looks limited. Hosts will keep watching it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if earnings growth falls below 15% p.a. target
- if CMD disappoints relative to high valuation
- if capital ratio buffer narrows toward FI requirement

> *"Aktien har gått jättebra. Den är ganska högt värderad. Så det är inte alls säkert att aktien sticker iväg på de nya målen."*

---

### 🟠 EKTA-B — Elekta | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

JP Morgan (cited analyst) put Elekta on a negative catalyst watch list; hosts unsure about any price effect because it just reported.

#### Reasoning

This is an analyst view (JP Morgan), not the hosts' own view. A negative catalyst watch implies near-term downside risk. The hosts did not know whether it would move the stock, since results were just released and no news is expected.

#### Sell Triggers

- if JP Morgan removes Elekta from the negative catalyst watch list
- if the next report beats expectations

> *"JP Morgan placerar Elekta på en negative catlist watch."*

---

### 🟠 HM-B — H&M | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Hosts expect H&M to be moved by the Inditex report: sales beat, operating profit slightly missed, sales +9% since August.

#### Reasoning

Inditex is H&M's closest rival, so its mixed report (sales beat, small profit miss, solid +9% start to autumn) could move H&M shares today. The hosts gave no direction; this is only a watch for peer read-across.

#### Sell Triggers

- if H&M's own sales trend falls behind Inditex's +9%

> *"Jag tror att H&amppms kan påverkas av Inditex rapport."*

---

### 🟠 CLA-B — Cloetta | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

US launch of Ahlgrens bilar is seen as a fun growth push, but the stock was downgraded yesterday after a strong run.

#### Reasoning

Cloetta has had a good run on the stock market and is now entering the US with Ahlgrens bilar, already stocked at Target. But it was downgraded yesterday, and the news was already known. The hosts' view is mixed, with no clear direction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the US launch fails to gain traction
- if more analyst downgrades follow

> *"Cloetta har haft en ganska bra resa på börsen. De blev nedgraderade igår, dock. Kul att de försöker ge sig in i USA."*
